Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment is a descriptive discovery study aimed at identifying nascent peptides (Na-PTPs) from polysome fractions in HEK293 and H1299 cells. While cycloheximide is used, it is a sample-preparation reagent to freeze ribosomes, not a biological perturbation variable for differential analysis. The study compares different cell lines (HEK293 vs H1299) and different RNA strands (sense vs antisense), but the MS analysis is used for identification/characterization rather than a controlled differential treatment experiment. Therefore, it is mapped as un-classified.
